findings.quote: Смеси бетонные тяжелого бетона (БСТ), класс В15 (М200)
findings.scope: Concrete curb at coverings other than cement concrete. Column ancestry checked on preceding page12, second column; row read on p13.
findings.positive_basis: Concrete class and rate match the declared VOR material/rate; F150 and W4 are not part of this resource row.
findings.limit: The resource name establishes neither zero environmental requirements nor sufficient durability of a chosen mix.

findings.quote: и, при необходимости, других нормируемых показателей качества
findings.meaning: F and W are legitimate additional specified quality characteristics in a concrete mix designation. They are not entailed by class B15 and the example B25/P1/F200/W4 is not a mandatory bedding recipe.
findings.positive_basis: Adding F150/W4 to a resource otherwise described only by B15 is not by itself a contradiction.
findings.limit: Valid designation syntax does not establish adequacy for the actual exposure or authorize arbitrary characteristics.

findings.quote: устанавливают в соответствии с нормами проектирования и указывают в проектной и технологической документации
findings.meaning: Strength, frost resistance and water tightness are separately classified; F1/F2 method prefixes are distinct. Assignment follows applicable design requirements and exposure; mix selection references ГОСТ31384.
findings.limit: B15 alone cannot derive F150/W4 or certify their compatibility.

findings.meaning: Road/aerodrome covering and base concrete requirements depend on structural layer and operating climate.
findings.limit: A curb bedding haunch is not automatically the structural pavement base addressed by this annex.

findings.quote: на бетонном основании с присыпкой грунтом с наружной стороны или укреплением бетоном
findings.meaning: Curb installation on concrete bedding is permitted; this clause does not prescribe a universal bedding F/W pair.
findings.excluded_transfer: The B25/F200 option on p23 addresses monolithic curb walls under combined special climate/permafrost conditions; the p23 F150 rule addresses exterior stair steps. Neither describes concrete bedding below precast curb stones.

findings.meaning: Section14 addresses construction of monolithic cement-concrete pavement/base layers, including moving slip forms or roller-compacted rigid mixes; project and technological requirements govern. No direct universal F150/W4 bedding minimum established.
findings.limit: The word основание is not sufficient to equate a narrow curb foundation with a pavement layer.

findings.meaning: These are layer-specific minima under road-pavement materials. Even though F150 numerically exceeds the tabulated base minima, applicability to curb bedding has not been established.
findings.limit: Cannot manufacture a compatibility proof by importing the less restrictive base row.

findings.meaning: Exposure classification distinguishes wetness and deicing salts. Е.1 distinguishes F1/F2 and winter five-day design temperature; wettest portion governs. Note3 redirects road structures to specialized standards. These are conditional design requirements, not future-batch passport conditions.
findings.limit: Do not apply generic Е.1 blindly to a road curb foundation, replace five-day temperature with monthly mean, or equate bare F150 with a tested method. Need the actual applicable design route, exposure, drainage/protection and intended frost method.

findings.meaning: PD39 specifies B30/F200 for the precast BR100.30.18 stone. PD76 TypeIII shows distinct road curb and lawn curb interfaces with foundation geometry.
findings.limit: Stone durability is not bedding durability; no literal bedding F150/W4 specification was identified in these reviewed details.

findings.quote: маркам бетона W4 – неагрессивные-среднеагрессивные, к маркам бетона W6, W8 – неагрессивные.
findings.additional_literal: По водопроницаемости для бетонов марок W4-W6, W10-W20 – неагрессивные.
findings.meaning: The project contains groundwater aggressiveness information; W4 cannot be presumed harmless throughout the project. Both adjacent statements are retained without silently resolving their differing scope.
findings.limit: The occurrence of an aggressive groundwater category does not prove contact with each bedding segment. Requires location/level, chemistry, drainage/protection and the underlying geotechnical assessment (PD27 references Приложение М).

findings.positive_fact: Table1.1 gives January monthly mean −17.4°C; PD18 mentions cold-day/five-day data but no numerical five-day0.92 value is printed on that reviewed page.
findings.limit: Monthly mean, absolute minimum and cold five-day design temperature are different metrics; no F minimum chosen by substituting one for another.

decision.reason: F150/W4 is a declared additional specification; compatible syntax and a B15 resource match are positive partial facts. Complete suitability for this actual bedding is not independently established. Exposure-sensitive normative conditions remain; absence of an explicit F/W minimum in GESN/SP82 is not a compatibility certificate.

exact_missing_facts: The applicable design classification for the precast-curb bedding/haunch, with a primary standard/project bridge rather than pavement-layer or curb-stone analogy.

For the actual locations of positions41/67: saturation/wetting, freeze-thaw, deicer exposure, groundwater contact/aggressiveness and protective measures, or an explicit approved project bedding durability specification/assessment resolving these conditions.
Intended frost-resistance test-method scope behind declared F150, where the selected standard requires F1/F2 distinction.

For W4: locate the relevant geotechnical water/soil chemistry assessment and establish whether the bedding is exposed to the project’s nonaggressive or medium-aggressive category; do not generalize PD15/27 to all curb segments.
not_required_for_this_audit: Passport/testing of a future concrete delivery merely to verify VOR specification and normative scope.
Repeated project wording of 5.9m3/100m where a genuinely applicable normative resource independently supplies it.
Importing B30/F200 of the manufactured curb stone into its bedding.
next_safe_step: Obtain/read existing designer bedding specification or detail-linked durability/exposure assessment; alternatively complete a bounded design-standard applicability check. Preserve B15/rate/quantity facts independently; no automatic confirmation or mismatch from unresolved F/W alone.
limits: No code, DB, active KB pin, production status or model runs changed.
Local sources first; additional online lookup used only generic normative document identifiers on official hosts, without project text.
Edition completeness of local copies is not recertified by this targeted audit.
